messages:
taylor: Kicking off Zephyr Financial POC thread. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning with group-filtering, RBAC via IdP groups, tenant domain locking, and a pricing sketch for a 4-week trial. Can someone pair on presales?

ravi: I can handle SSO/SCIM tech checks. Quick ask: do they require signed and encrypted assertions or just signed? Also, will they provision via SCIM only or want Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning from SAML?

lena: Security note from review: prefer encrypted assertions + assertion signing. They also want certificate rollover docs and support for JWK rotation endpoints if we publish them. Uploaded Zephyr_SecQ_2026.filled.pdf to secure drive.

carla: For RBAC mapping we usually map IdP group -> role slug -> permission set. We support group passthrough in SAML (attribute: groups) OR SCIM sync. If they want dynamic mapping, we can support regex group-to-role mapping in our console.

ravi: SCIM specifics: we support /scim/v2/Users with filter and pagination. If Zephyr wants group-limited sync, they can call /scim/v2/Users?filter=groups eq "zephyr-engineers". We also support incremental sync via /scim/v2/Users?since=<epoch>. Rate limits for trial: 120 reqs/min by default; can raise for dedicated. Example SCIM filter request:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users?filter=groups%20eq%20%22zephyr-engineers%22&startIndex=1&count=100"

ravi: For bulk provisioning we accept POST /Bulk with a list of user objects (SCIM bulk). We also support PATCH ops for updates.

lena: Regarding domain controls: we require DNS TXT for domain verification. If they want wildcard subdomain tenant locking (e.g., *.zephyr.com), they must add the TXT record at the apex and provide proof. We do not accept CNAME-only verification for tenant locking.

taylor: Pricing question from AE: Zephyr wants hosted POC with ~1k MAU, peak 300 concurrent sessions, estimated 150k tokens/day. Can we rough out hosted vs small dedicated pool and any discount for short trials?

pricing: For 4-week POC: Hosted estimate: metered usage + small trial credit - roughly $X/day for 150k tokens (we'll attach actual numbers). Small dedicated (reserved trial instance) estimate: flat monthly commit prorated for 4 weeks + infra surcharge, better latency and consistent p50/p95. We can propose a short reserved trial at 50% of our monthly small commit as a one-off. I'll draft a 1-pager.

carla: Test plan items: 1) Exchange SAML metadata (IdP metadata + want SP metadata?) 2) Validate assertion attributes (email, groups, role) 3) Test JIT sign-up vs SCIM bulk sync 4) Role assignment + API access validation 5) Domain lock and tenant routing tests 6) Cert rotation test. Can we get test IdP (Okta) accounts from them?

ravi: We should ask Zephyr to provide: IdP metadata XML, SCIM base URL + token template, list of groups to sync, desired role names, and expected provisioning cadence. Also ask if they need SCIM custom schema attrs (employeeId, manager, region).

lena: sec-bot: Note S-4 (cert rotation workflow) and S-9 (SCIM throttling/resilience) from their questionnaire. We've marked these as blockers until we provide mitigation notes.

ops-bot: Internal runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/enterprise-poc-auth (read-only). Also link to template SCIM mapping: https://internal.redwood.ai/templates/scim-mapping.csv

taylor: Action items: @ravi prep SAML/SCIM test checklist and sample metadata to send today. @pricing draft POC cost sheet by EOD. @carla prepare RBAC mapping examples and regex mapping guidance. I'll schedule kickoff Fri 9am PST with Zephyr and invite SE and infra.

carla: One more edge case: they asked about nested groups in IdP. We support nested groups if passed in assertion or if SCIM returns nestedGroup membership arrays, else we recommend flattening or syncing parent groups.

ravi: Also to call out: if they want Cert auto-rotation we can accept JWK set url for signature verification; otherwise manual X.509 upload + rotation notes. Ask them preference.

taylor: Thanks team — will post the customer docs once we have metadata. Zephyr contact: m.choi@zephyr-fin.com. Closing loop here :white_check_mark:
